slots.writingObjective: State as a fact about TextOS that its controlled preview is not a publication and shows the draft named by the handoff, never another one.
One sentence for a search result: in TextOS a controlled preview is internal and noindex, not a publication, and it refuses any draft whose fingerprints do not match the one handed over.

Open on the reader's situation — being asked to look at an AI draft before anything goes live, and wondering whether the page is already public and whether it is the version that was checked — and say that in TextOS a controlled preview is not a publication.
slots.buyerIntent: Is the page I am reviewing already out there?

slots.heading: How do you review an AI draft before anything is published?
slots.writingObjective: Answer directly: a draft reaches the preview only after the fact-check and the brief check both pass; the preview is internal and not a publication; and the preview opens the draft named by the handoff, recomputes its fingerprints and refuses any mismatch.
slots.buyerIntent: What happens between writing and my review?

slots.heading: A preview is not a publication
slots.writingObjective: Explain what the preview page is: kept out of search engines and archives, no public address and nothing public, no network and no live publishing; the fact-check state, the preview state and the publication state are kept apart; and a draft can be previewed again without losing its checked status.
slots.buyerIntent: Can a preview leak or count as publishing?

slots.heading: The page you read is the draft that was checked
slots.writingObjective: Explain the handover: the preview no longer picks the most recent draft; it opens the draft named by the handover record, recomputes the fingerprints and stops at the first mismatch without falling back to the latest draft; the fingerprint of the content is computed so it survives being stored and read back; and a draft written elsewhere and imported is rejected if it does not match its brief, evidence or instructions.
slots.buyerIntent: How do I know nothing was swapped?

slots.writingObjective: Caption the figure of this note in one factual sentence, grounded in the evidence it cites.

slots.heading: The page says how the draft was made
slots.writingObjective: Explain the provenance banner: the preview states whether the draft came from a live writing run or was imported or replayed, an unknown origin stops the preview instead of guessing, and the page says it is an internal preview, not a customer story; and explain that the preview record keeps fingerprints of the content, of the rendered page and of the file, and that the file written is checked against that record.
slots.buyerIntent: Will the preview tell me where the text came from?

slots.heading: What the preview does not decide
slots.writingObjective: Explain the limits honestly: the handover carries a draft and its fingerprints but says nothing about the content itself; only a fact-checked draft tied to an accepted brief can be previewed, so the preview is downstream of checks, not a check of quality; publication is a separate state the preview does not change; judging substance stays with the reader.
slots.buyerIntent: Does a clean preview mean the article is good?

slots.writingObjective: Give the buyer a short list of questions to put to any vendor, one per sentence, drawn from the mechanisms this note describes. Recommendations only, no claim about TextOS.
